Scenario/Locations/Ansion/Khorun-Expanse.title: Abandoned Cobalt Mine
Scenario/Locations/Ansion/Khorun-Expanse.content:
Description 
                  
                

An old cobalt mine located near the trading town of Dashbalar. Due to increasing offworld imports and decreasing ore  yields, it was abandoned a few cycles ago. Rumours speak of much larger deposits remaining at greater depths, and with the price of the mineral rising again, due to price-gouging from Imperial merchants, the local population has considered re-opening the mine. This currently seems unlikely, however, as bandits from Tormudai Fortress appear to have occupied the mine since.

Scenario/Locations/Ansion/Khorun-Expanse.title: Dashbalar
Scenario/Locations/Ansion/Khorun-Expanse.content:
Public Holonet Entry 
                  
                

The trade town Dashbalar originated as the final rest area and supply hub for Alwari caravans crossing the Khorun Expanse east onto the Sorr-ul-Paan Plateau and Cuipernam, or west towards the canyons of Delgerhan. The town is built at the foot of a cliff marked by a lone rock spire, serving since ancient times as a guiding marker for caravans traversing the expanse. Its very name is said to be the extinct local Alwari dialect’s term for “great spire”.
While much fewer caravans traverse the planet today, Dashbalar continues to be the regions largest settlement and has preserved its role as the local supply and logistics hub. The town is also a favored trading center of the Alwari Qulun clan.

Scenario/Locations/Ansion/Khorun-Expanse.title: Old Riverport
Scenario/Locations/Ansion/Khorun-Expanse.content:
Description 
                  
                

A decade ago, this riverport was a core component of the logistics infrastructure in and around the trade town of Dashbalar, but changes to the natural water cycle of Ansion have diminished the river significantly. While the change in water levels was initially compensated by dredging a channel along the river’s center, this practice soon proved to be unviable over following cycles. As a result, the port has largely been abandoned today, and the cargo that was previously processed here is now being handled further downstream, from where it is then moved to Dashbalar overland.
